description: Requirement identification, classification and attribute extraction. Each document lists the gold requirements (verbatim substrings); every other line is a non-requirement (heading, boilerplate, note, permission, scope statement). Attribute values are in canonical units (V, A, W, VA, Hz, mm, mm2, MPa, m3/h, mg/L, NTU, %, degC, kg/m3, rpm, dB, ratio, pH). Labelled by the StandardOS authors; see eval/README.md for annotation guidelines and known limitations.

TENDER NO. PWD/EL/2026/112
SECTION 4 — TECHNICAL SPECIFICATION
4.1 General
4.1.1 The feeder pillar shall be of outdoor type, fabricated from 2 mm CRCA sheet.
4.1.2 Degree of protection shall be IP55.
4.1.3 The bidder should furnish drawings for approval within 15 days.
4.2 Electrical
4.2.1 Rated voltage: 415 V
4.2.2 Busbars shall be rated for 400 A continuous current.
4.2.3 Short circuit withstand: 35 kA for 1 s.
Note: Drawings are indicative only.
4.2.4 Earthing terminals shall be provided at two points.

documents.text:
SCHEDULE OF TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS
1. The treatment plant shall produce 2 MLD of potable water.
2. Treated water pH: 7.0 to 8.5
3. Residual chlorine at the farthest point shall be at least 0.2 mg/l.
4. Turbidity of treated water shall not be more than 1 NTU.
5. The contractor may use locally available sand for filter media if approved.
6. Operation and maintenance manuals shall be submitted in triplicate.
The plant is located near the river.

documents.text:
PARTICULAR SPECIFICATIONS — CIVIL WORKS
a) Concrete for the raft foundation shall be M30 grade.
b) Reinforcement: Fe 550D TMT bars.
c) Minimum cement content shall be 320 kg/m3.
d) Curing shall be continued for at least 10 days.
e) Formwork shall be removed only after approval of the Engineer.
f) Slump of concrete: 75 mm to 100 mm
The work is to be completed within 9 months.

documents.text:
TECHNICAL SPECIFICATION FOR LT CABLES
1.0 SCOPE
1.1 This specification covers supply of LT XLPE cables.
2.0 REQUIREMENTS
2.1 Cables shall be 1.1 kV grade, XLPE insulated, PVC sheathed and armoured.
2.2 Conductor shall be stranded aluminium of size 240 sq mm.
2.3 The maximum conductor temperature shall be 90 °C under normal operation.
2.4 Cable drums shall be marked with the manufacturer's name and year of manufacture.
2.5 Test certificates shall be furnished with each consignment.
Page 2 of 5

documents.text:
PUMPING MACHINERY
(i) Pumps shall be horizontal split casing type suitable for raw water.
(ii) Each pump shall deliver 450 m3/hr against a total head of 35 m.
(iii) Pump speed shall not exceed 1500 rpm.
(iv) The pump efficiency at duty point shall not be less than 80 %.
(v) Noise level at 1 m distance shall not exceed 85 dB(A).
(vi) The Engineer's decision shall be final.

documents.text:
QUALITY OF TREATED WATER
Treated water shall meet the following limits:
- pH: 6.5 – 8.5
- Total hardness (as CaCO3): 200 mg/l max
- Iron: 0.3 mg/l max
- Chloride: not more than 250 mg/l
- E. coli: shall not be detectable in any 100 ml sample
Sampling shall be done weekly.

documents.text:
DISTRIBUTION TRANSFORMER — 630 kVA
The transformer shall be of 630 kVA rating, 11/0.433 kV, Dyn11 vector group.
Temperature rise of oil shall not exceed 35 °C over an ambient of 50 °C.
No-load losses and load losses shall be guaranteed values.
The transformer tank shall be painted with epoxy paint.
Delivery period: 12 weeks

documents.text:
SPECIFICATION FOR STREET LIGHTING
Clause 5 — Luminaires
5.1 Luminaires shall be LED type with a minimum efficacy of 110 lm/W.
5.2 The luminaire housing shall have ingress protection of IP66.
5.3 Luminaires shall operate on 230 V ± 10 %, 50 Hz single phase supply.
5.4 The supplier shall provide a warranty of 5 years.
5.5 Poles shall be hot dip galvanised.
Photometric reports shall be submitted along with the bid.

RCC WATER TANK — DESIGN DATA
Design shall be based on IS 3370 for liquid retaining structures.
Grade of concrete: M30
Clear cover: 40 mm
Maximum crack width shall be limited to 0.2 mm.
Reinforcement shall be Fe 500D.
The tank shall be tested for water tightness before commissioning.
